description: This file defines a helper class 'Log' that provides a wrapper around Android's native logging framework. It manages a chain of LogNode objects for custom logging, exposes methods for different log levels (verbose, debug, info, warn, error, assert), and allows setting and retrieving the current LogNode.

classes.name: Log
classes.description: A helper class for managing and dispatching log messages to a chain of LogNode objects, providing an interface similar to Android's Log class with additional flexibility.

methods.name: getLogNode
methods.description: Returns the current LogNode in the linked list.

methods.name: setLogNode
methods.description: Sets the LogNode data will be sent to.

methods.name: println
methods.description: Dispatches a log message to the current LogNode, with specified priority, tag, message, and throwable.

methods.name: v
methods.description: Logs a verbose message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: d
methods.description: Logs a debug message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: i
methods.description: Logs an info message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: w
methods.description: Logs a warning message or throwable.

methods.name: e
methods.description: Logs an error message, with optional throwable.

methods.name: wtf
methods.description: Logs an assert message or throwable.
